name: Sakayaki
source:
Today is the entrance ceremony for Kanrai senior high school.
The heroine, Haraoki Rei, while hurrying on the way to school collides with this one single boy.
Having a helping hand entended to her, what she saw when raising her gaze is…!?

It’s the love story of deep love, that the boys and girls + Sakayaki inerveawe.

[from [url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/05/29/otome-game-review-aya-no-kuni-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
今天是关莱高中的入学典礼。
女主人公原木丽在赶路的路上与这个单身男孩发生了冲突。
本来想伸出援助之手的她，一抬头看到的却是……！？

少男少女+坂烧令人心潮澎湃的深爱爱情故事。

[来自[url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/05/29/otome-game-review-aya-no-kuni-special/]Koorin的博客[/url]]
